>
[Mask of Mercy](/Equipment.aspx?ID=963)
</title>

<spoilers>May contain spoilers from Strength of Thousands</spoilers>

<traits>
<trait label="Uncommon" url="/Traits.aspx?ID=159" />
<trait label="Fortune" url="/Traits.aspx?ID=76" />
<trait label="Invested" url="/Traits.aspx?ID=98" />
<trait label="Magical" url="/Traits.aspx?ID=103" />
<trait label="Necromancy" url="/Traits.aspx?ID=117" />
</traits>

<column gap="tiny">

**Source** [Pathfinder #169: Kindled Magic](/Sources.aspx?ID=94) pg. 74, [Treasure Vault](/Sources.aspx?ID=191) pg. 154 <sup>1.1</sup>

**Price** 100 gp

<row gap="medium">

**Usage** worn mask

</row>

<row gap="medium">

 

 

 
</row>

</column>

---

This porcelain or alabaster mask portrays an angelic visage of kindness and mercy.

**Activate** <actions string="Free Action" /> envision ([fortune](/Traits.aspx?ID=76)) **Frequency** once per day; **Trigger** You are about to roll a variable number of Hit Points you restore from an action with the [healing](/Domains.aspx?ID=15) trait;  **Effect** Roll twice to determine the number of Hit Points you restore and take the higher result.

<column gap="tiny">

</column>
